commits.summary: Folio: StudioSequence/StudioTrack/StudioClip timeline document members on integer Ticks

REMEDIATION R2-review-a (SMB-FOLIO-ENG-1): remove SequenceFrameRate::fps_fraction from Folio (CX-CAP-001; Pulse owns frame-rate conversion), add hsk_studio_pulse::fps_fraction_of(&SequenceFrameRate); Folio handle() rejects relative/path-like media and primitive handles; +1 folio test, pulse test extended

remediation_r2.finding_1_cx_cap_001: CONFIRMED and fixed: SequenceFrameRate::fps_fraction deleted from hsk-studio-folio (only caller was the folio timeline_contract test; no other crate used it). Folio keeps ticks_per_frame storage, accord() canonical-rate validation and its private gcd (still used by Speed validity). New hsk_studio_pulse::fps_fraction_of(&SequenceFrameRate) -> Result<(u64,u64), PulseError::UnsupportedFrameRate> = accord() canonical check + pulse fps_fraction (single implementation). Behaviour change: non-canonical ticks_per_frame (previously returned a fraction for any nonzero value) is now UnsupportedFrameRate; validated documents are always canonical
remediation_r2.finding_2_path_handles: CONFIRMED and fixed: handle() accepted relative paths (media/a.mov, ./a.mov, ../a.mov, file:///a.mov) because it refused only backslash, leading slash and drive prefix, contradicting its own doc and ClipSource 'never a filesystem path'. Now refuses any '/' or '\', '~' prefix, bare '.' and '..'; applies to ClipSource::Media artifact_manifest_id and ClipSource::Primitive object_id; same typed error as before (Code::InvalidField, target '<clip_id>/source'); no new Code variant. New test path_like_handles_are_rejected_for_media_and_primitive_sources (11 path spellings x media+primitive rejected; opaque ids manifest-a, offline-reel-A001.mov, a..b still accepted)

tests.clippy_tests_folio_pulse: PASS no warnings in folio/pulse (2 pre-existing too-many-arguments warnings in hsk-studio-observe, not touched)
tests.check_tests_dependents: PASS: chronicle, package, pigment, composite, interop-psd, session, interop-media (cargo check --tests); folio+pulse --all-targets PASS

remediation_r2.not_touched_out_of_scope: hsk-studio-interop-media/src/time.rs:114 carries its own fps_fraction copy (and edl.rs uses it): same CX-CAP-001 class, owned by the interop-media lane

capabilities_done: New src/timeline.rs: StudioSequence, StudioTrack, StudioClip (schema ids hsk.studio.sequence|track|clip@1), SequenceFrameRate{ticks_per_frame}, Speed{numerator:i64,denominator:u64}, ClipSource{Media|Sequence|Primitive}, TrackKind{video,audio,caption,submix}, consts MAX_SEQUENCES/MAX_TRACKS_PER_SEQUENCE/MAX_CLIPS_PER_SEQUENCE/MAX_HANDLE_BYTES
StudioDocument.sequences: optional member (serde default, omitted when empty): absent == empty, encoding of existing documents unchanged
All time fields hsk_studio_accord::Ticks (plain u64 on the wire via serde with-module + schemars with=u64)

Validation: STRK/SCLP ids unique doc-wide; per-kind track index == order; source_in < source_out; speed reduced nonzero (sign = reverse); duration == (out-in)*den/|num| exactly; clips ordered by timeline_start and non-overlapping (touching ok); sequence duration == last clip end; canonical STU-VID-013 frame rate only (legacy 10594594594/8475675675 rejected); media handle never a path; nested sequence dangling + cycle; Budget.nodes counts sequences+tracks+clips, payload_bytes counts names/handles; hard ceilings
Resolver::media defaulted method (Absent); media/primitive sources yield ResolutionIssue targets '<clip_id>/source'; require_available covers them
extension(): sequences key allowed; sequence/track/clip @N schema mismatch retained read-only; unknown fields read-only via serde deny_unknown_fields
DESCRIPTOR input text mentions timeline members

tests.downstream_check: cargo check --tests PASS for chronicle, pigment, package, composite
tests.tree: shared edit tree == committed 89201e7 for crates/hsk-studio-folio (git status clean)

decisions_for_lead: frame_rate stored as {ticks_per_frame:u64} per STU-VID-011 (not num/den); exact reduced fraction via hsk_studio_pulse::fps_fraction_of(&SequenceFrameRate) (e.g. 24000/1001; Folio no longer carries fps_fraction after R2 remediation d2f4a5b); only canonical STU-VID-013 table values accepted
sequence_id is a document-local key: v02.215 declares no sequence identity prefix (accord has none, STU-CON-004 table lists none)
reversal carried by speed sign only (spec lists both a reversed flag and negative speed; Pulse uses the sign)
sequence.duration == last clip end exactly is MY choice (spec silent); clip order by timeline_start required (Pulse lanes are ordered)
not stored yet: settings record, markers, in/out, work area, effect_stack, transitions, label_color, track height/audio routing

no new Code variants and no Budget fields added (strict additivity); overlap/order/duration use Code::InvalidField with target suffix /overlap /unordered /duration; StudioDocument gained a pub field: struct-literal constructors need sequences: Vec::new() (none exist in the workspace)
